arStrings.szText:
Knives have a {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%|]{/c} chance to shatter into {c_number}[SF_18]{/c} shards of metal on hit, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} becomes a {c_important}Marksman{/c} Skill.
{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} now throws a fan of {c_number}{SF_54}{/c} knives that each deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} now drops grenades instead of knives, each dealing {c_number}{payload:GRENADE_IMPACT}{/c}.

{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} is also a {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skill.
{c_important}Dance of Knives'{/c} Energy Cost is reduced to {c_number}{SF_29}{/c}.
{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} gains {c_number}[SF_46 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased Lucky Hit Chance.

{c_important}Dance of Knives{/c} Slows enemies hit by {c_number}[SF_8*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:MOD_SLOW}{/c} seconds and grants {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|x%|]{/c} Movement Speed while Channeling.
{c_important}Dance of Knives'{/c} knives has a {c_number}[SF_24 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to pierce and grenades' explosion area is increased by {c_number}[SF_50 * 100|+%|]{/c}.
